experiment: free triangle BLAMP; product ring in both variants
notes: All integer n*f1+m*f2 products lie on the declared family grid for the exact rational source ratio. This permits an off-family residual measure; arbitrary irrational ratios would make dense masks invalid.
Off-family energy misses aliases that land on valid families. Family amplitudes versus192k output are also reported; no phase/time/pitch/gain fitting is applied.
The same FIR coefficients scale their physical passband with sample rate. Both raw family-amplitude error and a correction for its known linear magnitude response are reported.
Product paths use raw oscillator inputs without the experimental physical coupling. The one-second preroll settles envelope and filter state. No phase, pitch, or gain fitting is used.

Numerical rate consistency is not evidence of hardware parity. Cross-rate family amplitude differences can include accumulated float phase drift and coincident-family cancellation; they are diagnostics, not pure alias error. The same-rate raw/AA low-band comparison avoids that confound.
